title: The Wind-Up Penguin
can_do: 用“先……然后……”解释一个玩具的操作步骤，让对方操作成功。

conversation_move.label: explain how a toy works step by step

trigger: Dad does not know how the new toy works, so Child walks him through it.
setting: The living-room table with a new toy.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: First, you open the little door on its back.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! Then you wind the key three times.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Put it down, and let go. It walks by itself!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Look at it go! Does it ever fall?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Sometimes. Then you start again with the key.

replay_cards.title: The music box
replay_cards.change: Child knows how to wind it.
replay_cards.challenge: Child explains where the key goes and how many turns it needs, and Grandma restarts it herself.

replay_cards.title: The vacuum robot
replay_cards.setting: The robot cleaner waits by its dock.
replay_cards.change: Dad pretends he forgot how to start it.
replay_cards.challenge: Child explains the button sequence, they check the result together, and the robot hums away.

parent_support: 家里的玩具、电器请孩子当“讲解员”，大人装笨提问。
孩子讲步骤时帮他用上“先、然后”，把顺序说清。
讲完让他看着你操作一遍，验收自己的教学。
